old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a piece of corn on the cob, with a pat of butter resting atop it. The corn is vibrant yellow, with each kernel clearly defined and glistening, suggesting it is freshly cooked or steamed. The butter is a pale yellow and begins to melt, with drips forming and flowing over the corn kernels as the sequence progresses. The background remains consistently black throughout the video, ensuring all attention is focused on the corn and butter. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady, fixed position, providing a clear and uninterrupted view of the melting butter and the glistening corn kernels.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a piece of corn on the cob, with a pat of butter resting atop it. The corn is vibrant yellow, with each kernel clearly defined and glistening, suggesting it is freshly cooked or steamed. The butter is a pale yellow, slightly melting, indicating it has been at room temperature for some time. As the video progresses, the butter begins to melt further, with small droplets of liquid butter forming around the edges of the pat. The melting process is gradual, with the butter becoming more fluid and spreading slightly over the surface of the corn. The background remains consistently black throughout the video, ensuring all attention is focused on the corn and butter. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady, fixed position, providing a clear and uninterrupted view of the melting butter and the glistening corn kernels.
caption: The video captures a macro close-up of a single rectangular pat of pale-yellow butter resting atop a horizontal cob of plump yellow kernels against a solid black background. The melting is already underway when the excerpt opens, with the pat's crisp edges and corners slowly softening and rounding instead of holding their shape. As the sequence advances, the bottom face of the butter sags and bulges downward into the gaps between the kernels, forming an increasingly wavy, drooping contour that deepens near the center-right. A glossy, wet sheen of liquefied butter spreads across the kernels directly beneath and around the pat, growing more conspicuous along the left side later on. The top surface remains roughly level and fixed in position, so the visible change is a deformation and phase transition of the pat itself rather than any translation across the cob. The corn and the dark backdrop hold steady frame to frame, keeping the camera static. The process stays open-ended, the pat still slumping as the excerpt runs out.
